title: WikiIndexDocumentDeletedPayload
description: wiki.index_document.deleted v1 (OpenVibe.Wiki server/wiki/service.js sync, via openvibe-publishing/index-hooks indexEvent). A Search tombstone: the page is no longer published, public and listable, so Search drops it at this revision or older. Only sent for a page Search was sent before. Consumed by OpenVibe.Search ('*.index_document.*'). Envelope: subject { type: page, id, revision }, visibility internal, priority important, actor service:wiki.

revision.description: Index revision of the tombstone; wins over any document at the same or an older revision.
